# actors-poc

> Stateful TypeScript services on Cloudflare Durable Objects. Define an actor, call it by key. Do not write Durable Object classes, bindings, migrations or IDs: the `actors` CLI generates them.

## Project layout (required)
- Actors: any file under `src/`, exported as `export const Name = actor({...})` (discovery depends on this exact form).
- Worker: `src/index.ts` with `export default { fetch }`.
- Run: `actors dev`. Deploy: `actors deploy`. Never edit `.actors/` or the `main`/`ACTORS`/`actors-v1` entries in wrangler.jsonc.

## Define
```ts
import { actor } from "actors-poc";
export const Cart = actor({
  state: (key: string) => ({ owner: key, items: [] as { sku: string; qty: number }[] }), // JSON only; annotate empty arrays
  actions: {
    add: ({ state }, sku: string, qty: number = 1) => { state.items.push({ sku, qty }); return state.items.length; },
    clear: (ctx) => { ctx.state = { ...ctx.state, items: [] }; },
    list: ({ state }) => state.items,
  },
});
```

## Call (from the Worker or another actor)
```ts
import { Cart } from "./actors/cart";
const n = await Cart.get(userId).add("sku-1", 2); // typed; returns Promise<number>
```

## Rules
- Mutate `ctx.state` (or reassign it). Committed when the action returns, discarded when it throws.
- State must be plain JSON: no Date, Map, Set, class instances or undefined in arrays. Store dates as ISO strings or epoch ms. Max 2 MB; put bigger data in `ctx.sql`.
- Actions on one instance run one at a time. Never await a call to the same actor from inside its own action (deadlock).
- External side effects (fetch, other actors, `ctx.sql` writes) are not rolled back.
- Calls are not retried. Catch `ActorError` and branch on `err.kind`: "action" | "validation" | "config" | "transport" | "timeout". `err.code` carries a `code` you set on a thrown error.
- Delay work: `ctx.schedule(seconds, "actionName", ...args)` (transactional, at least once).
- Log for debugging: `ctx.log(...)`. Hide secrets from dev tools: `redact: { state: ["token"], args: ["setToken"] }`.
- Keys are addresses, not auth. Derive them from an authenticated identity.

## WebSockets
```ts
import { actor, typed } from "actors-poc";
export const Room = actor({
  state: { messages: [] as string[] },
  connections: {
    data: typed<{ user: string }>(),                 // set by the Worker, never by the client
    onConnect(ctx, conn) { conn.send({ history: ctx.state.messages }); },  // throw → client gets 403
    onMessage(ctx, conn, msg) { ctx.state.messages.push(String(msg)); ctx.broadcast({ from: conn.data.user, msg }); },
    onClose(ctx, conn) { ctx.broadcast({ left: conn.data.user }); },
  },
  actions: { online: (ctx) => ctx.connections().map((c) => c.data.user) },
});
// Worker fetch handler (after auth): return Room.connect(roomId, request, { data: { user } });
```
- Hooks are actions (queued, transactional). Sends and broadcasts go out only if the hook/action commits; delivery is at-most-once.

## Raw Durable Objects (when an actor isn't enough)
```ts
// src/session.ts: any file under src/. No wrangler.jsonc edits: `actors generate` adds binding SESSION + migration.
import { DurableObject } from "cloudflare:workers";
export class Session extends DurableObject { async ask(q: string) { return q; } }
// caller
import { durable } from "actors-poc";
await durable(Session).get("demo").ask("hi"); // typed stub
```

## Debug
- `actors inspect <Type> <key>`: state, recent calls, errors with stacks, logs, schedules.
- http://localhost:8787/__actors: Actor Explorer (dev only).
